comparison.objective: Uncork a wine bottle while it remains in its cradle.
comparison.physical_skill: Stabilize a bottle; engage, turn, and pull a corkscrew against extraction resistance.
comparison.success_condition: Cork extracted and moved clear; bottle remains within cradle tolerances; tool and hands released/clear.
comparison.reason: No selective many-body separation through apertures, screen agitation, retained washers, or screen reseating.
